scheme_name: Pension to the Disabled Person, Chandigarh
department: Social Welfare, Women & Child Development, Chandigarh Administration
benefit_summary: Rs. 1,000 per annum (40-70% disability); Rs. 2,000 per annum (>70%)

citation.quote: The applicant's disability must be to the extent of 40% or above then they will be eligible to avail the benefit of same.
The applicant must be a resident of UT Chandigarh for more than 3 years.
The family income of the applicant should not exceed Rs. 1.50 lacs annually.
